verdict.rationale: Rainforest has no native automation engine, but its event webhooks plus a documented no-code Zapier integration let platforms build workflows that run unattended, for example reacting when a merchant application moves to Needs Information. Merchant deposits also run on a configurable frequency. Background automation therefore depends on an external tool (Zapier) or custom webhook consumers, with nothing agentic or AI-driven. Missing for 10: native first-party automation or scheduling builder, AI or agent-driven autonomous workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
